item.text: I’ll trace how report downloads check role grants, fix the auditor’s inherited access, and run the relevant tests.

The grant resolver ignores parent roles, which explains the auditor’s 403. Analysts succeed through a separate shortcut that also bypasses explicit denials. I’ll make downloads use the shared policy and add parent-role traversal with cycle protection.

item.text:
Fixed ACCESS-284. Role grants now follow parent links, so auditors inherit `report:download`.

Analyst downloads use the same policy, preserving inherited access while respecting explicit denials. Cycles and missing roles are handled safely.

All 5 tests pass, including the auditor regression test.
